'''Dermon''' was a [[Jenn Aiel]].

==Appearance==
Dermon was a tall, gaunt man with white hair and blue eyes.

==History==
Dermon speaks for the [[Jenn Aiel]], with [[Mordaine]] and [[Narisse]], when the sept chiefs were invited to [[Rhuidean]].{{ref/book|4|25}}
